scope: Five natural-support unpenalized shared-inflation CPU regression families and portable prediction; partial JMP19.2 coverage.
integration_status: Verified on matching macOS arm64 CPU dev/Debug C ABI and loaded DuckDB SQL; bounded contract only.

common_contract.families: 0ZI Binomial,1ZI Beta Binomial,2ZI Poisson,3ZI Negative Binomial NB2,4ZI Gamma(shape=mu/sigma,scale=sigma). Binomial-family means use logit; other base means use log. One shared auxiliary pi.
common_contract.fit_support: Finite nonempty rectangular numeric data,<=100000rows,<=16features,<=1Mcells,abs(data)<=1e150. Frequencies integer>=0,sum<=1e9 and greater than full parameter count. Zero-frequency rows omitted after global finite/shape validation. Trials integer<=1e6,positive for binomial,>1 for beta-binomial,exact1 for other families. Counts natural integers<=1e6;Gamma zero or positive.
common_contract.identification: Reject all-zero data,constant positive Gamma data,all-success binomial data,intercept-only Bernoulli inflation confounding and rank-deficient normalized fixed features. Other finite-MLE/global existence is not certified.
common_contract.optimization: Observed likelihood with row analytic second derivatives,Newton/BFGS line search,multiple interior starts and exact pi0 and beta-binomial/NB dispersion0 lower-model candidates. Mean objective normalized by total integer frequency. Parameter guardabs60,reported convergence additionallyabs<40;atabs>=25 joint inference is withheld.
common_contract.uncertainty: Interior converged PD observed information only. Native model-based and HC0 covariances both returned;selected kind controls saved mean delta Wald SE/CI. HC0 meat=sum frequency*individual_score outer product,not squared frequency. No finite-sample multiplier. Displayed covariance coordinates are original beta including intercept,physical native dispersion when present,physical pi. Wald intervals are untruncated.
common_contract.prediction: Returns base mean,mixture mean/variance,zero probability,query mass,separate positive Gamma density,CDF,direct survival,left generalized-inverse quantile,linear predictor,optional mean delta SE/CI. No atom is represented as a density. Negative query hasCDF0/SF1;fractional count query hasmass0 andfloor CDF.
common_contract.saved_model: [1,family,p,confidence,covariance_kind,has_covariance,at_boundary,normalized_beta(p+1),physical_dispersion_or0,pi,feature_origins(p),feature_mean_offsets(p),feature_scales(p),normalized_beta_physical_aux_covariance_flat(d*d)] with d=p+2+[dispersion family],length10+4p+d*d. Exact length and flags,finite values,positive scales,native parameter domains,symmetric PD enabled covariance or all-zero disabled covariance validated. No training rows required.
common_contract.limits: Cumulative200M algorithmic work units across starts,likelihood,information,inversion,tails and quantiles. Count means/queries/quantiles<=1e6 except finite-support queries beyondtrials. Gamma shape[1e-8,1e7];positive sub-f64 quantiles fail explicitly. Derived nonfinite outputs fail. Work units are algorithmic,not machine instruction counts.
remaining_for_full_parity: Lasso/Elastic Net,selection/validation and default observational JMP Lasso are not implemented by these unpenalized methods.
Fractional discrete response/trials,analytic weights,informative missing,categorical contrasts and exact JMP roles remain unsupported.
Exact JMP sandwich,finite-sample correction,auxiliary CI transformations and installed-JMP comparison remain unverified.
Multi-start local optimization does not certify a global optimum or general finite-MLE existence.

operations.description: Saved zero-inflation distribution prediction: [features...,trials,query response,quantile probability]; exact zi-fit.predict_parameters carrier. Joint selected-covariance mean delta Wald inference only for interior identified fits.
operations.data: [same numeric feature order as training...,trials,query response,quantile probability strictly(0,1)]
args: exact unchanged version1 predict_parameters from any zi fit
unsupported: Conditional quantile is a native convenience,not a claim of an identical JMP saved column.
At-boundary/nonconverged/unidentified models cannot supply joint Wald inference.
Positive Gamma quantiles below the smallest f64 and exhausted numerical budgets return NULL.
